name: inputmask
title: Input Mask
description: Formats what the user types into a pattern, such as phone numbers, dates or decimals.

attributes.name: data-maska
attributes.description: maska's mask pattern: # is a digit, @ a letter, * a letter or digit, e.g. "##/##/####". A JSON-like list of patterns picks the one that fits the input length.

attributes.name: data-maska-number
attributes.description: maska's number mode: formats the value as a number with grouping.

attributes.name: data-maska-number-fraction
attributes.description: Number of decimal places in number mode.

attributes.name: data-maska-number-unsigned
attributes.description: Disallows negative numbers in number mode.

notes: All data-maska* attributes belong to maska; see its documentation for every option, such as custom tokens and eager mode.

examples.title: Dynamic mask
examples.description: Switches pattern as the value grows.
